name: Pinned chapters
look: Each step depends on the last and shows a distinct result. For independent details use a compact list or captioned views side by side.
reduced: Each step stays with its text and complete visual. Desktop uses two columns and phones stack them.
phone: Each complete step and its picture follow in order.

needs.words: 2 to 4 steps, a title and two lines each
needs.pictures: one picture or screen per step
